console.name: dependency-downloader
console.title: Maven Dependency Downloader
console.description: Displays information about dependencies downloaded at runtime

dependencies.description: The downloaded dependency class-path entries (only present when the application classloader manages downloads)

offline.description: Whether downloading is disabled (only present when a downloader is active)

fresh.description: Whether fresh downloads are forced (only present when a downloader is active)

verbose.description: Whether verbose logging is enabled (only present when a downloader is active)

repos.description: The extra Maven repositories (only present when a downloader is active)

repoId.description: The Maven repository id the artifact was downloaded from

repoUrl.description: The Maven repository URL the artifact was downloaded from

downloads.description: The downloaded artifacts (only present when a downloader is active)
